timing_notes.amortized: request+setup+cleanup HTTP divided by attempted requests; excludes admission waits and unmeasured cleanup bookkeeping
timing_notes.continuation: 18 original logical slots; cumulative physical fragments preserve the unique frozen prefix. First local request is cold even when its scheduled_index exceeds 1. Between-collection request-boundary gaps are separate, include cleanup/admission/setup, and are not pure off-run pause or added to supervisor overhead
timing_notes.inspection: full eligible records materialized by exact cosine scans; unique per attempt, not low-level SQLite index access
timing_notes.nested: loading, prefill and decoding are nested backend metadata; never add them to wall spans
timing_notes.primary: all attempted complete request walls, including failures and each physical fragment's cold first load; interrupted attempts are retained once
timing_notes.supervisor_overhead: separate physical-fragment supervisor elapsed minus worker session wall, including prior rejected launches/guards/waits and import/exit/sealing residual; original fatal fragment with no terminal event remains unavailable; not pure waiting and not added twice with rejected worker time
